item.title: Week 11: Steelers at Eagles
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: PIT -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model PHI 37% vs. market 35% | Philadelphia's offense must create chunk plays from a unit ranked 32nd in explosive play rate, while Pittsburgh's tacklers, 4th in yards after catch over expected, have to cap them. Jaylen Warren, first in rushing yards over expected at +2.1 per carry, runs into a Philadelphia run defense ranked 16th, and that gap is where Pittsburgh wants to live. Our model has Pittsburgh at 63 percent, a touch below the market's 65, and the rushing matchup drives most of that lean.
